title: .gitignore, README, .gitmodules notes
description:
Add repository hygiene docs/files for ShredWidth. Independent of processor work (wave 1 with a.1).

Before editing, inspect:
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredeq/.gitignore and README.md
- /home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/.gitmodules
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md purpose blurb and §15 build notes
- Existing a.1 .gitmodules if present (do not fight the JUCE pin; only document it)

Implement:
1. .gitignore including at least: build/, cmake-build-*, state/, .abracapocus/state/, .abracapocus/logs/, .abracapocus/reports/, plus common CMake/IDE/plugin artifacts (compile_commands.json, .idea optional per sibling style).
2. README.md: project name ShredWidth; one-paragraph description (static micro-pitch detuner / lead widener, deterministic, no LFO); formats VST3/CLAP/LV2/Standalone; C++20/JUCE; build steps: git submodule update --init --recursive; ./scripts/build_all.sh (note CLion-bundled cmake because cmake may not be on PATH); mention SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER default 2; point to .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md for full spec.
3. .gitmodules notes: if .gitmodules is missing, create the JUCE submodule entry matching aural-maximizer-pro URL/path and note the required pin (tag 8.0.13). If a.1 already wrote .gitmodules, only add a short README subsection documenting the pin and clap-juce-extensions expectation — do not regress the pin commit. Prefer not rewriting .gitmodules when a.1 owns the pin; only touch .gitmodules when absent.

Do not touch Source/ or CMakeLists.txt build logic.
acceptance_criteria: .gitignore exists and ignores build/, cmake-build-*, state/, .abracapocus/state/, .abracapocus/logs/, .abracapocus/reports/
README.md describes ShredWidth, supported formats, submodule init, and scripts/build_all.sh / CLion cmake note
README.md references ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md or .abracapocus spec location
JUCE submodule pin is documented in README and/or .gitmodules without conflicting with a.1
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change JUCE pin away from aural-maximizer-pro 8.0.13 if .gitmodules already set by a.1

allowed: document clap-juce-extensions submodule expectation in README
forbidden: overwrite a.1 JUCE commit pin with a different revision
